summary: Kennametal Inc. filed an 8-K on August 18, 2026, announcing the appointment of Richard J. Harshman and Dawne Hickton to its Board of Directors, effective September 1, 2026, until the next annual meeting. Both are seasoned executives with backgrounds in specialty materials and manufacturing. They will not initially serve on committees but are expected to join later. They are eligible for customary non-employee director compensation and expense reimbursement. This is a routine board appointment, not a special situation; no strategic transaction, tender, or activist event is indicated.
